title: Jalapeno Quesadilla
description: Crispy jalapeno quesadillas make a perfect snack or meal. The spicy kick from jalapeno pairs well with the savory flavor of common cheese.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Slice the jalapeno into thin strips.
In a bowl, mix the sliced jalapeno with the so.
Place a flour tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle shredded cheese on half of the tortilla.
Add the jalapeno-so mixture on top of the cheese.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for another 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also crispy.
Cut the quesadilla into wedges and serve hot.
Serve with your favorite dipping sauce, if desired.
